info.title: SPARQL EasyQuery API
info.description: Build and execute constrained SPARQL queries against uploaded, built-in, or remote RDF graphs. Query operations are public; account operations use the HttpOnly easyquery_session session cookie.

get.description: Returns process health and the last known database state (ready, not-configured or unavailable). It answers 200 whatever the database state and never waits for a connection attempt. Its only side effect: at most one background database check or reconnection every 5 seconds.

200.description: The application process is healthy; `database` reports the database state.

get.description: Returns the built-in graphs and Wikidata the frontend offers. Each id is accepted as endpointUrl by the query routes; uploaded graphs are not listed.

200.description: Selectable endpoints with kind local or remote.

post.description: Parses a required ttlFile part and stores the graph in the process-local sliding cache. The returned opaque identifier is used as endpointUrl by query routes.

requestBody.description: Multipart form containing one Turtle file.

200.description: Opaque identifier for the cached graph.

400.description: ttlFile is missing or the Turtle document is invalid.

post.summary: List relationships for an RDF element
post.description: Builds and executes the relationship query for the selected endpoint. limit is retained for request compatibility but is not consumed by this operation.

200.description: Relationships mapped to application property values.

400.description: Malformed JSON, missing/invalid fields, invalid endpoint, or invalid generated query.

404.description: The selected uploaded local graph is unavailable.

502.description: Remote SPARQL or Wikidata execution failed.

post.summary: List values for a subject and predicate
post.description: Builds and executes the relationship-value query for the selected endpoint. subjectId and predicateId are semantically required; limit is accepted but unused.

200.description: Relationship values mapped to application property values.

400.description: Malformed JSON, missing/invalid fields, invalid endpoint, or invalid generated query.

404.description: The selected uploaded local graph is unavailable.

502.description: Remote SPARQL or Wikidata execution failed.

post.description: Uses Wikidata entity search for the Wikidata endpoint and generated SPARQL for other endpoints. A null, omitted, or empty search returns an empty data array.

200.description: Matching nodes mapped to application property values.

400.description: Malformed JSON, missing/invalid fields, invalid endpoint, or invalid generated query.

404.description: The selected uploaded local graph is unavailable.

502.description: Remote SPARQL or Wikidata execution failed.

post.description: Generates constrained SPARQL from the requested graph patterns and executes it. variableName and where are semantically required; where may be an empty array.

200.description: Query results mapped to application property values.

400.description: Malformed JSON, missing/invalid fields, invalid endpoint, or invalid generated query.

404.description: The selected uploaded local graph is unavailable.

502.description: Remote SPARQL or Wikidata execution failed.

post.summary: List typed candidates for one exploration stage
post.description: Returns one bounded, ordered page of distinct typed RDF terms for variableName under previously committed typed bindings. Labels are display-only. Maximum/Minimum filters and blank-node bindings are rejected.

400.description: Malformed JSON, missing/invalid fields, invalid endpoint, or invalid generated query.

404.description: The selected uploaded local graph is unavailable.

502.description: Remote SPARQL or Wikidata execution failed.

post.summary: Profile the numeric values of one relation
post.description: Returns count, min, max and up to limit distinct entity/value pairs, ordered by value, for subject predicate ?value under the where patterns. Only numeric literals are included. Maximum/Minimum filters are rejected.

400.description: Malformed JSON, missing/invalid fields, invalid endpoint, or invalid generated query.

404.description: The selected uploaded local graph is unavailable.

502.description: Remote SPARQL or Wikidata execution failed.

post.summary: Count the distinct values of one query variable
post.description: Returns the number of distinct values of variableName under the where patterns, without a LIMIT and without the rdf:type requirement of the general query. where needs at least one pattern. Maximum/Minimum keep every value tied at the extreme of the rest of the query.

400.description: Malformed JSON, missing/invalid fields, invalid endpoint, or invalid generated query.

404.description: The selected uploaded local graph is unavailable.

502.description: Remote SPARQL or Wikidata execution failed.

post.description: Uses the general-query request shape. ignoreWikidata and filterType do not affect this route.

400.description: Malformed JSON, missing/invalid fields, invalid endpoint, or invalid generated query.

404.description: The selected uploaded local graph is unavailable.

post.summary: Create an account and log in
post.description: Self-registration with a username (3 to 32 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'; unique regardless of case) and a password of 8 to 128 characters. Starts a session: sets the HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax easyquery_session cookie. Same origin only: a mismatching Origin is rejected with 403 and a non-JSON body with 415. Attempts are limited per client address.

201.description: The account exists and the session cookie is set.

400.description: Invalid username or password format, or malformed JSON.

403.description: The Origin header names another site.

429.description: Too many login or registration attempts from this address in the last minute.

503.description: The account database is not configured or unreachable.

post.description: Starts a new session (a session cookie sent with the request is discarded). A failed login does not reveal whether the username exists. Same origin only: a mismatching Origin is rejected with 403 and a non-JSON body with 415. Attempts are limited per client address.

200.description: Logged in; the session cookie is set.

400.description: Username or password missing, or malformed JSON.

403.description: The Origin header names another site.

429.description: Too many login or registration attempts from this address in the last minute.

503.description: The account database is not configured or unreachable.

post.description: Requires a session. Deletes it and clears the cookie. Same origin only: a mismatching Origin is rejected with 403 and a non-JSON body with 415.

403.description: The Origin header names another site.

429.description: Too many login or registration attempts from this address in the last minute.

503.description: The account database is not configured or unreachable.

get.description: Returns the logged-in user, or 401 without a valid, unexpired session.

503.description: The account database is not configured or unreachable.

post.description: Runs the reference query on the task's endpoint with the result cap and stores its result as the expected one (revision 1). A reference returning more than the cap is rejected. Requires the admin role (401 without a session, 403 for a participant). Same origin only: a mismatching Origin is rejected with 403 and a non-JSON body with 415. Unknown body fields are ignored; expected rows are never read from the client.

409.description: A task with this key exists.

400.description: Invalid or malformed body, or the query could not run.

403.description: The user lacks the role, or the request came from another site.

503.description: The database is not configured or unreachable.

get.description: Every task, active or not, ordered by key. Requires the admin role (401 without a session, 403 for a participant).

403.description: The user lacks the role, or the request came from another site.

503.description: The database is not configured or unreachable.

post.summary: Run a reference query without saving
post.description: The expected result a task with this reference would store. Requires the admin role (401 without a session, 403 for a participant). Same origin only: a mismatching Origin is rejected with 403 and a non-JSON body with 415. Unknown body fields are ignored; expected rows are never read from the client.

403.description: The user lacks the role, or the request came from another site.

put.description: Replaces the task's fields (the key stays). The reference runs again when its request, the endpoint or the cap changed; changing the statement, reference request, comparison, endpoint or cap increments the revision, a title or layout change does not. Requires the admin role (401 without a session, 403 for a participant). Same origin only: a mismatching Origin is rejected with 403 and a non-JSON body with 415. Unknown body fields are ignored; expected rows are never read from the client.

403.description: The user lacks the role, or the request came from another site.

post.description: A name of 1 to 100 characters, unique. Requires the admin role (401 without a session, 403 for a participant). Same origin only: a mismatching Origin is rejected with 403 and a non-JSON body with 415.

put.description: Replaces the group's tasks with these keys, in the order participants see them. Unknown or repeated keys are rejected with 400. Inactive tasks may be listed; participants do not see them. Requires the admin role (401 without a session, 403 for a participant). Same origin only: a mismatching Origin is rejected with 403 and a non-JSON body with 415.

200.description: The group with its new tasks.

400.description: Invalid or malformed body, or the query could not run.

post.summary: Put a participant in a group
post.description: A participant is in at most one group: one already in another group is moved, keeping their submissions. An unknown username or an admin is rejected with 400. Requires the admin role (401 without a session, 403 for a participant). Same origin only: a mismatching Origin is rejected with 403 and a non-JSON body with 415.

400.description: Invalid or malformed body, or the query could not run.

403.description: The user lacks the role, or the request came from another site.

post.summary: Take a participant out of a group
post.description: The participant then has no tasks. A user not in the group is rejected with 400. Requires the admin role (401 without a session, 403 for a participant). Same origin only: a mismatching Origin is rejected with 403 and a non-JSON body with 415.

get.description: The active tasks of the caller's group, in the group's order; empty without a group. Requires a session (401 otherwise).

200.description: Key, title and a one-paragraph summary of the statement.

503.description: The database is not configured or unreachable.

get.description: The statement, endpoint and optional starting graph (formatVersion 1); never the reference query or the expected result. The first open by the caller is recorded (time spent is measured from it). Requires a session (401 otherwise).

404.description: No active task with this key in the caller's group.

503.description: The database is not configured or unreachable.

post.summary: Submit a drawn query as an answer
post.description: The body is the drawn graph (formatVersion 1) and the request derived from it, whose variableName is the answer variable. The server runs it on the task's endpoint with the task's result cap, compares with the stored expected result (set or multiset) and stores the attempt with the task revision and the time since the first open. Attempts are unlimited. Unknown fields such as `correct` are ignored. A query that cannot run is stored as an invalid attempt (201, invalid true). The response never contains expected values. Same origin only (403) and JSON only (415). Requires a session (401 otherwise).

400.description: Malformed body: missing graph or query, or a request that is not a query.

404.description: No active task with this key in the caller's group.

503.description: The database is not configured or unreachable.

get.summary: List my attempts at a task
get.description: The caller's own attempts at the task given by `?task=<key>`, oldest first. Requires a session (401 otherwise).

400.description: The task parameter is missing.

503.description: The database is not configured or unreachable.

ttlFile.description: UTF-8 Turtle document uploaded as a file.

filterType.description: Literal filter: 0 Starts, 1 Contains, 2 Greater/equal, 3 Lesser/equal, 4 Max, 5 Min, 6 Between (object min..max, both inclusive).

variableName.description: The filtered SPARQL variable, with or without the leading ?.

filterType.description: 0 Starts, 1 Contains, 2 Greater/equal, 3 Lesser/equal, 6 Between (value min..max).

variableFilters.description: FE-034: variables restricted to literal values, each the object of a where pattern; optional.

value.description: IRI without angle brackets, literal lexical form, or blank-node label.

bindings.description: Committed typed bindings; blank nodes are rejected.

variableFilters.description: FE-034: variables restricted to literal values, each the object of a where pattern; optional.

where.description: The query without the profiled relation; may be empty.

subject.description: Subject of the profiled relation: a SPARQL variable or an IRI in angle brackets.

predicate.description: Profiled predicate IRI in angle brackets.

limit.description: Maximum number of values returned, 1 to 1000.

variableFilters.description: FE-034: variables restricted to literal values, each the object of a where pattern; optional.

count.description: Distinct entity/value pairs with a numeric value.

truncated.description: True when values holds fewer pairs than count.

variableName.description: Counted SPARQL variable, with or without the leading ?.

where.description: Graph patterns; at least one. Maximum/Minimum keep every value tied at the extreme of the rest (BE-004).

variableFilters.description: FE-034: variables restricted to literal values, each the object of a where pattern; optional.

count.description: Distinct values of variableName under where; no LIMIT applies.

variableName.description: The answer variable, with or without the leading ?.

graph.description: The drawn graph in the saved-query format (formatVersion 1), stored as sent.

key.description: Stable key, 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits or '-'. Ignored on update (the path wins).

endpoint.description: A built-in local graph id, such as PokemonGen1.

startingGraph.description: Optional saved query (formatVersion 1) the participant's editor starts from.

maxResults.description: Result cap for the reference and the answers, 1 to 10000.

expected.description: Typed terms of the answer variable, one per result row.

attempt.description: 1 for the user's first attempt at the task, then 2, 3, …

invalid.description: The query could not be built or run; the counts are null.

timeSpentMs.description: Milliseconds since the user first opened the task, measured on the server.
